study.hypothesis: For finite inherited u and c, the legacy expression has value u and derivative with respect to u equal to multiplication by c. A custom identity-forward Function returning u and backward(upstream)=upstream*c removes the product-shaped surrogate multiply, subtract and add in the forward pass, while keeping the normalization autograd graph, detached donor-scale coefficient and all parameter paths. Those eliminated operations may be large enough to reduce training cost; Python autograd dispatch, allocation behavior, sorting, feature gathering and the MLP may instead dominate. This is a computational implementation hypothesis with no predicted accuracy gain, no new architecture claim and no assertion of training-wide bitwise equivalence.
